body:
### Summary

When running [uv-installer.ps1](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/download/0.12.23/uv-installer.ps1) in Windows with `HTTPS_PROXY` and `NO_PROXY` environment variables used:

- HTTPS_PROXY value is used.
- NO_PROXY value is discarded.

This is an issue for my organisation, as internal assets cannot be accessed through the proxy, and we use an internal mirror for `UV_INSTALLER_GITHUB_BASE_URL`.

The part that fails is:
`function WebProxyFromEnvironment {
    $httpsProxy = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("HTTPS_PROXY")
    $allProxy = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("ALL_PROXY")
    $proxyUrl = if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($httpsProxy)) { $httpsProxy } else { $allProxy }
    $webProxy = WebProxyFromUrl -ProxyUrl $proxyUrl
    return $webProxy
}`

One correction could be (maybe with added null check):
`function WebProxyFromEnvironment {
    $httpsProxy = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("HTTPS_PROXY")
    $allProxy = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("ALL_PROXY")
    $noProxy = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("NO_PROXY")
    $proxyUrl = if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($httpsProxy)) { $httpsProxy } else { $allProxy }
    $webProxy = WebProxyFromUrl -ProxyUrl $proxyUrl -BypassList $noProxy
    return $webProxy
}`

My team would be happy to contribute with your approval: however, i cannot find the source code for the standalone installer. 

### Platform

Windows 11 x64

### Version

0.12.23

### Python version

_No response_
